question: Can case feedback induce conditional executable prescription-repair skills with empirical exceptions that reduce reference-relative omissions, extras and joint-order errors on new patients?
dataset: eICU-CRD v2.0; adult ICU stays; inputs available by minute 360; medication orders entered in [360,720)
patient_exclusion: Exclude every uniquepid in v25 members, then select one stay per patient before sampling. Earlier eICU population audits existed. Audit hospitals were previously development hospitals for other patients; this is new-patient evaluation, not globally unseen hospitals.
diagnoses: At least one recorded clinical disease-system category, diagnosisOffset between 0 and 360; exclude discharge status and diagnosisPriority. Recorded diagnoses may include resolved or ruled-out conditions.
multisystem: At least two distinct predecision clinical disease-system categories; acute or chronic. Not a validated chronic multimorbidity phenotype. Half of each split sampled from each stratum using input only.
labels: Native HICL identity, route, dosage string, frequency string. Exclude stays with unidentified target HICL. Retain zero-target stays and all target drugs outside the candidate vocabulary. No RxNorm equivalence or MIMIC Core4 pooling.
source_tools: Frozen v25 seed42 uniform round4 predictor and conditional order compiler, threshold0.1; trained on40000 previous training stays. No new fitting. Same training bank and input catalogue for all arms.
skill_language: Executable condition -> procedural repair, with unless conditions; operations recover_consensus, prune_unsupported, contextual_order, reconcile_prior. No drug-name predicates, per-drug thresholds, new weights, invented doses, or free-form generated code.
learner: Deterministic failure-guided symbolic program induction. Select an operator from reference-relative error type, search observable scopes, and infer at most one exception from harmful training applications. This is bounded procedural memory learning, not proof of recursive optimizer improvement.
gates: Minimum4 scope-positive training cases,2 scope-negative cases; strictly reduce summed FN+FP+joint symmetric difference on seen training cases with no aggregate increase in any of3 components. Rank candidates on proposal data under same Pareto constraint; evaluate at most top3 on guard; accept at most1 per round with strict total improvement and componentwise nonincrease on both gates. No audit access during selection.
counterexamples: Distinguish off-scope negatives from observed harmful applications. An exception needs at least2 harmful seen cases; otherwise explicitly record that no empirical harmful exception was established. No mandatory acceptance.
actor: Local Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 greedy, one call,256 output tokens; a complete catalogue-valid JSON object or bare array accepted consistently. Frozen predictor is separately evaluated. Llama3.2-3B transfer uses first128 hash-selected audit patients. No patient material sent to cloud.
controls: learned rules without scope and exceptions
primary_metrics: missed unique target drugs per patient
complete native4 joint symmetric-difference errors per patient
uncertainty: Paired patient bootstrap2000 replicates; report each prespecified stratum and endpoint, without treating intervals as a multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory test. All six frozen states evaluated only after selection ends.
limitations: Retrospective reference agreement is not clinical appropriateness. Full pharmacy administration fields and monitoring plans unavailable. Human review pending. No claim that every round improves, skills are novel clinical discoveries, or existing strongest methods are surpassed.
spend: Local inference only in this experiment; new paid API expenditure zero. Prior authorized USD10 remains a cumulative cap, with USD0.085203 already used.
